flag.name: TT_BIO_SDPA_GRID_Q_CHUNK

arms.on: shipped default, the grid rule picks the q_chunk

flag.switch: module attribute plus cache_clear on _grid_q_chunk, _sdpa_q_chunk and _sdpa_program_config_for_shape, inside one process and one device context
flag.question: the SIGN of a default-ON flag, not a new lever

design.order: on off off on per rep (ABBA): the lever sits at positions 1 and 4, so a linear drift across a rep cancels in the rep contrast
design.warmup: one census fold per arm before any timing, so neither arm pays first-mover program-config build inside the timed sequence
design.AA_control: drawn from the SAME rep sequence: the middle off|off pair of every rep and the on|on rep boundary, never a separate session
design.primary_statistic: median of the 16 adjacent cross-pair deltas off_minus_on_s, percentile-bootstrap 95 % CI, seed 0, 20000 resamples
design.secondary_statistic: median of the 8 drift-immune ABBA rep contrasts
design.sign_convention: off_minus_on_s > 0 means the flag ON is FASTER, i.e. the shipped default is right

AA_floor_source: c10-bare-baseline bc66f7d6d: median adjacent absolute A/A pair delta, same card, same clock, same timer

clock.below_1200: clock artifact; reject timing, never call regression

host_cpu_witness.foreign: any process outside the run session (own=false)

accuracy.metric: maximum independently superposed domain all-atom float64 Kabsch RMSD, split after residue 298; also report whole-chain all-atom
accuracy.cross_arm: the flag changes a grid decision, so the CIF digest is compared between arms; a moved digest is scored in Angstrom against the size bar, not an automatic kill

kill: wrong source/config or input hashes, or the flag set in the environment
flag default is not the shipped ON
wrong opened node, containment change or boot change
foreign device holder, foreign host CPU at or above 20 % of a core, or quiet/lock timeout
clock read error, wrong clock or coverage gap
the chunk census shows a site moving with the flag OFF, or nothing moving with it ON
cross-arm structural deviation over the size bar
fewer than 16 accepted cross pairs or 12 accepted A/A pairs
bare: Production wheel, no Tracy/graph/observer/module timers/sum profiling. Synchronize before monotonic start and after predict_one including CIF writing. The per-call chunk census runs only on the two discarded warm-up folds, never inside a timed one.
unmeasured: No device-cycle census, no per-op attribution, no split of wall time into device work and host gaps, no upstream accuracy, no other card and no second session.
no_production_change: This directory measures the shipped tree. It changes no production file and flips no default.
